answer: What keeps this honest is Registered soil surveyor log with agricultural research standing, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the vault here is verification, the relic of cost is what stops the farm, and the ember of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
